verdict.rationale: Alloy is an identity, fraud and compliance SaaS platform, so processing-region and cross-border data handling is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers data residency, deployment regions, contracted processing locations, or cross-border transfer handling. The items cover events, webhooks, workflows, health monitoring and SSO, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can verify the contracted processing region and cross-border handling for the chosen deployment
